data.title: Bitcoin Price Pumps Above $80,000: Jason Calacanis Challenges Michael Saylor and Cathie Wood
data.description: Bitcoin price touched the $84,000 level just now after breaching $80,000 last week. This movement has prompted investor Jason Calacanis to characterize the move as a dead-cat bounce.
